ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white florets with a slightly bumpy, granular surface, clustered into a branched piece about 6 cm long and 3 cm wide, with a thick pale stalk section below and a fibrous, translucent-looking pale green-white base; matte, no browning or char, sits alone on the upper-left area of a white square plate, about 2.5 cm tall | 45

ITEM 2 | Pale cream-white florets with fine granular bumpy surface forming a cluster about 4 cm by 3 cm, with a pale yellowish-green stem base; matte and dry-looking, no browning, sits on the lower-center of a white square plate, about 2 cm tall | 25

ITEM 3 | Pale cream-white florets with a slightly bumpy texture forming a cluster about 5 cm by 4 cm, with pale green-tinged fibrous stem core visible at the base; matte, uncooked-looking or lightly cooked, no browning, sits at the bottom-center of a white square plate, about 3 cm tall | 40

ITEM 4 | Small pale cream florets in a loose cluster about 3 cm by 3 cm with a pale green stalk piece, matte and dry, no browning, sits at the right of the lower group on a white square plate, about 2.5 cm tall | 30

ITEM 5 | Pale cream-white florets in a cluster about 3 cm by 2.5 cm with fine granular surface and a light green stem edge, matte, no browning, sits between the lower-left and right clusters on a white square plate, about 2 cm tall | 20
